en: Ezekiel 1

zh: 以西結所見的第一個異象

p.src: 1  Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

en: Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
u.src: 1  Now in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river Chebar, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

ja: 1:1 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。
en: 1:1 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 2  In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,

ja: その月の五日、エホヤキン
en: In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
u.src: 2  In the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,

p.src: 3  the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.

en: the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.
u.src: 3  the LORD’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the LORD’s hand was there on him.

ja: 1:3 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」はヘブル語のיהוה（ヤハウェ）から来ている。ただし、短い形のיה（ヤハ）から来ていると記されている場合を除く。
en: 1:3 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 4  I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

ja: があり、火がひらめき、その
心からは、輝く金属のようなものが見えた。
en: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.
u.src: 4  I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

ja: 1:4 「見よ」はヘブル語「הִנֵּה」またはギリシア語「ἰδοὺ」に由来し、「見なさい」「注意せよ」「よく見よ」という意味の間投詞である。
en: 1:4 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 5  Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

en: Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
u.src: 5  Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.

p.src: 6  Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

en: Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.
u.src: 6  Everyone had four faces, and each one of them had four wings.

p.src: 7  Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

en: Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.
u.src: 7  Their feet were straight feet. The sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot; and they sparkled like burnished bronze.

p.src: 8  They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

en: They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:
u.src: 8  They had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides. The four of them had their faces and their wings like this:

p.src: 9  Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

ja: えず、それぞれまっすぐ
en: Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.
u.src: 9  Their wings were joined to one another. They didn’t turn when they went. Each one went straight forward.

p.src: 10  As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

en: As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.
u.src: 10  As for the likeness of their faces, they had the face of a man. The four of them had the face of a lion on the right side. The four of them had the face of an ox on the left side. The four of them also had the face of an eagle.

p.src: 11  Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.

ja: 方に広げられ、それぞれ
en: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.
u.src: 11  Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above. Two wings of each one touched another, and two covered their bodies.

p.src: 12  Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

en: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
u.src: 12  Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

p.src: 13  As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

ja: のようであり、たいまつのように見えた。
き巡り、火は明るく、その
en: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.
u.src: 13  As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches. The fire went up and down among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and lightning went out of the fire.

p.src: 14  The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

ja: がひらめくように行き来した。
en: The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
u.src: 14  The living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

p.src: 15  Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

ja: よ、四つの生き物のそれぞれのそばに、
en: Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.
u.src: 15  Now as I saw the living creatures, behold, there was one wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, for each of the four faces of it.

p.src: 16  The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

ja: をしていた。その外観と作りは、一つの車
en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.
u.src: 16  The appearance of the wheels and their work was like a beryl. The four of them had one likeness. Their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel within a wheel.

p.src: 17  When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

en: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.
u.src: 17  When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn when they went.

p.src: 18  As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

ja: ろしいほどであり、四つの車輪の縁には周囲一面に目があった。
en: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
u.src: 18  As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.

p.src: 19  When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

en: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
u.src: 19  When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them. When the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

p.src: 20  Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

ja: こうとしたからである。車
en: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
u.src: 20  Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

p.src: 21  When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

en: When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
u.src: 21  When those went, these went. When those stood, these stood. When those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

p.src: 22  Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

ja: のような大空があり、その
en: Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
u.src: 22  Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.

p.src: 23  Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

ja: を互いに向けてまっすぐ
en: Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
u.src: 23  Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.

p.src: 24  When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

ja: のとどろきのようであり、
のようであり、軍勢の音のような激しい響きであった。
en: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.
u.src: 24  When they went, I heard the noise of their wings like the noise of great waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a noise of tumult like the noise of an army. When they stood, they let down their wings.

p.src: 25  There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

en: There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.
u.src: 25  There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

p.src: 26  Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

ja: には、サファイア のように
える王座に似たものがあった。その王
に似た方が座しておられた。
en: Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
u.src: 26  Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.

en: 1:26 or, lapis lazuli

p.src: 27  I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

ja: のようであった。また、その方の
en: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
u.src: 27  I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

p.src: 28  As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.

ja: のようであった。 これが
に似たものの姿であった。
en: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
u.src: 28  As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of the LORD’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
